rotate.title: Please rotate to landscape
rotate.body: This screen works in landscape on a tablet or desktop (minimum 1024×768).
s0.title: Facial Asymmetry Screen
s0.subtitle: A screening aid — not a diagnostic device.
s0.disclaimer: This tool measures facial movement asymmetry. It does not diagnose stroke. If symptoms are sudden, call 995 now.
s1.consentText: Processing happens on this device. No video or images leave the browser.
s1.dataShare: I consent to my de-identified results being sent to a secure research spreadsheet
s1.name: Full name
emergency.title: Call 995 now
emergency.fast: FAST: Face drooping, Arm weakness, Speech difficulty — Time to call 995.
s2.tip.light: Face an even light source; avoid side lighting.
phase.rest: Relax your face and look at the dot
phase.brow: Raise both eyebrows as high as you can
phase.eyeGentle: Close your eyes gently, like sleeping
phase.smile: Give me a big smile showing your teeth
phase.pucker: Purse your lips forward into a kiss shape, as if saying oo
result.995: If symptoms are sudden, call 995 now.
result.amber: Mild asymmetry measured. Compare with your baseline or seek medical advice.
result.red: Significant one-sided facial weakness pattern measured.
result.unable: Could not measure reliably. Please repeat.
result.995cta: If symptoms are sudden, call 995 now
result.disclaimer: Screening aid, not a diagnostic device. Research use only. Thresholds provisional.
clin.caveat: Expression output is not felt emotion and can be biased by facial weakness. Research use only.
